const managedService = `[Unit]
Description=NetBird private management network and SSH
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment=NB_FORCE_RELAY=true
Environment=NB_LAZY_CONN=on
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/netbird service run --config /var/lib/netbird/config.json --log-file console
Restart=always
RestartSec=10s
TimeoutStopSec=30s
StateDirectory=netbird
StateDirectoryMode=0700
KillMode=process
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
`

func managedUnitSettings(body string) string {
	var settings strings.Builder
	for line := range strings.SplitSeq(body, "\n") {
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
			continue
		}
		settings.WriteString(line)
		settings.WriteByte('\n')
	}
	return settings.String()
}

[Unit]
Description=NetBird private management network and SSH
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
# Cell servers reach NetBird only through the gateway /32 on TCP 443 and UDP
# 3478, with no internet route, so ICE to operators or the routing peer can
# never succeed. Skip ICE and use the relay at once (NetBird 0.79 reads
# NB_FORCE_RELAY=true in the daemon). Lazy connections (NB_LAZY_CONN, the
# replacement for the inert --enable-lazy-connection flag) open a tunnel only
# when an operator connects. Intra-region cluster traffic uses VCN private IPs
# and never NetBird. The enrollment CLI runs with a scrubbed environment.
Environment=NB_FORCE_RELAY=true
Environment=NB_LAZY_CONN=on
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/netbird service run --config /var/lib/netbird/config.json --log-file console
Restart=always
RestartSec=10s
TimeoutStopSec=30s
StateDirectory=netbird
StateDirectoryMode=0700
# The daemon serves NetBird SSH. Like ssh.service it stays unconfined: login
# and su sessions need root privileges, PAM, setuid helpers and the full
# filesystem. A restart issued from a session must not kill that command.
KillMode=process
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

install.detail: managedClient.install validates fixture values, takes real OS lock, reads real journal and bootstrap sentinel, obtains staged path (so Fetch/download branch is not reached), verifies file bytes, snapshots state and prior executable, retains rollback file, writes units/journal/config/live binary, then calls synthetic systemctl/status/enroll. Each root limits its assertions to the actual reached branch.

filesystem.detail: Actual direct directories, protected descriptor reads (NONBLOCK/NOFOLLOW), flock, atomic temporary-write/sync/rename/directory-sync, and removal paths. These production operations execute on fixture files if the test runs; no execution occurred during this review.

binary.detail: installManagedBinary makes private actual file copy before verifying it, then chmod/sync/rename. copyFile opens bounded direct nonblocking source; VerifyBinary reads ELF header and actual byte digest. Hostile FIFO/symlink/oversized sources are rejected through OS open/stat, not a synthetic path predicate.

journal.detail: readTransaction reads private bounded pending.json and validates decoded state; writeTransaction marshals then atomically writes the same file. Real disk readback supports persisted state and stale identity assertions.

snapshot.detail: backupState uses stubbed enable query, opens actual protected state descriptors, writes snapshot bodies/state.json; restoreState verifies saved manifest/digests before restoring/removing actual files, merging managed hosts entries, and issuing synthetic systemd actions.

retention.detail: Copies synthetic fixture rollback-worker ELF bytes to actual transaction directory; ready checks validate real inode metadata, then armRollback verifies copied executable and writes actual timer/service files. No retained executable is started by these roots.

recovery.detail: recover holds actual flock, reads actual journal, reads actual timer and retained executable; malformed FIFO timer sets configured false, then armRollback atomic file guard rejects replacing FIFO. The snapshot FIFO case instead fails readManagedStateFile while backupState holds installation lock.

finish.detail: finish/finishMode delegates to finishModeWithProof, which locks and reads actual journal before transaction identity/deadline branches. finishTransaction verifies actual prior binary and restores real enrollment/unit/hosts files or removes first-install binary, then atomically stores completed journal. All service actions remain test closures; copying managedClient does not restart a process.

enabled_decoder.detail: managedUnitEnabledResult examines strings/errors and exec.ExitError exit code locally. Test sh exits create typed error fixtures; neither systemd nor a project child process observable is asserted. Process setup is incidental to decoder classification.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION: source categories are not compile/runtime results; no receipts reviewed.

All filesystem roots use a temporary fake host root and synthetic minimal ELF headers; no executable artifact or real NetBird daemon is executed by these roots except incidental sh exit-error fixtures in decoder test.
systemctl/status/enroll are Go closures. No live systemd, Vault, enrollment, OCI, NetBird network, signing or cloud boundary is qualified.

Actual filesystem operations/readbacks and OS flock support only the explicit local boundaries. No crash/power-loss durability, independent process restart, network formation or cloud behavior is inferred.
All negative, redaction, ordering, identity, ownership, inode, retry, file-preservation and rollback obligations remain retained; no deletion/retirement/count/global completion promotion authorized.
